name: fetch_items
description: Fetch new items for each active `sources` row of type `papers` (PubMed, Europe PMC incl. medRxiv/bioRxiv preprints, ClinicalTrials.gov, arXiv) or `feeds` (RSS/Atom URLs and Google News queries), using the search terms stored on the row, and store them in `source_items` as `pending` for the screener. `web` sources are skipped: the screener finds those with web search.
